education: B.A., LL.B. (Special) Educated at Basaveshvar Vidya Vardhak College, Bagalkot and Raja Lakhamagouda Law College, Belgaum, Karnataka
present_address: Flat No. 704, Narmada Apartments, Dr. B.D. Marg, Near R.M.L. Hospital, New Delhi NCT of Delhi, 110001

social_activities:
The social life commenced with joining the student movement in early 1970s with prominence on prevailing issues. Has been rigorously working for the elevation off the persecuted and depressed sections of the society. Broadly involved in different social, cultural activities and associated with a number of cultural organizations.
Work is Worship has been the life mantra throughout. Mentored various projects to improve the livelihood of farmers and downtrodden in the Bagalkot region, Karnataka and instill a sense of self-respect in them.
interests:
Social work, national development, service of poor and differently abled person through various mediums. Moots for sustainable development. Keen interest in promoting handloom, handicraft, boosting tourism, organic
farming. Creating awareness about preserving ecological balance to protect mother earth.
hobbies: Reading, watching documentaries depicting Indian history, public interaction, organic farming.
sports: Played Chess, Volleyball, Kabaddi during school and college days and enjoyed the occasional Swim
